note: BLM (Malta Field Office) campground in the Little Rocky Mountains near Zortman, part of the Camp Creek Recreation Area (with adjacent Horse Corral CG and Buffington Day Use). Trails lead from the campground (hiking, birding, OHV); Zortman has a store, restaurant and fuel. Reached from US-191 by the 7-mile Road or Bear Gulch Road (7 miles each). Gravel-access, drive-in RV sites. --Claude
